name: Stormcaller's Crook
flavour: The thunder walks beside its owner.
note: Lightning gem level, lightning damage and a long shock on a staff.

name: Stormcaller's Spire
flavour: It draws the sky to a point.
note: Lightning gem level, lightning damage, maximum lightning resistance and penetration.

name: Embertooth Totem
flavour: It guards the door when the fire is low.
note: Life, regeneration and evasion on low life.

name: Pearl of Plenty
flavour: Round, smooth, and full of other people's mana.
note: A deep mana pool with extra regeneration.

name: Gilded Pall
flavour: Wealth makes a heavy shroud.
note: Huge armour, evasion and energy shield with all resistances and life and mana on kill.

name: Silk-soft Steps
flavour: Nothing the wearer cannot slip away from.
note: Evasion, life, movement speed and dodging spells.

name: Wyrm's Gut
flavour: Swallowed whole, and warmer than expected.
note: Armour and life percentage with flask life recovery rate.

name: Pass of Two Winters
flavour: Two fires, one cold road.
note: Fire damage, added cold to attacks and spells, and damage while ignited.

name: Charcoal Ring
flavour: The core of a log that would not burn.
note: Physical damage, added chaos to attacks, life and regeneration.

name: Clotted Grip
flavour: Held tight until it forgets how to let go.
note: Added physical, life, flat regeneration, flask life recovery and no extra bleed damage from moving.

name: Thirsting Paw
flavour: It drinks while it is still in the wound.
note: Physical damage, attack speed, leech and instant leech on a claw.

name: Thornjerkin
flavour: Do not hug the wearer.
note: Reflect most of a melee hit and take less from attacks, with added physical.

name: Brinewalker Boots
flavour: They never quite dried out.
note: Energy shield, physical and projectile damage, lightning resistance and movement speed.

name: Quickhide Wrap
flavour: Light enough to forget it is armour.
note: Attack speed, evasion, cold resistance, movement speed and flask mana recovery.

name: Pellet Sceptre
flavour: It rains on whoever disagrees.
note: Physical and elemental damage, added damage per ten strength and attack speed on a sceptre.

name: Pact Ring
flavour: Sworn in frost, sealed in lightning.
note: Cold and lightning resistance, lightning damage, spells always shock frozen enemies.

name: Slaughter Pendant
flavour: It beats faster the more there is to bleed.
note: All attributes and resistances, attack leech, damage while leeching and faster leech.

name: Smouldering Bulwark
flavour: A shield that keeps the hearth lit.
note: Armour, life, fire resistance, added fire to attacks and spells, curses enemies with Feeble Grip.

name: Gilded Malice
flavour: Beauty, with the knife behind the back.
note: Chaos damage, armour and evasion, life and faster life leech.

name: Pyre Robe
flavour: Warm to wear, worse to touch.
note: Fire resistance, ignite chance and duration, reflect fire and take physical as fire.

name: Briar Circlet
flavour: It gives as good as it gets, and a little more.
note: Energy shield, reflect physical, extra physical taken from attacks and Pain Conduit.

name: Salute of the Pit
flavour: Bow first, then strike.
note: Fire and cold resistance, movement speed on full life, melee damage, reach, at half the energy shield.

name: Last Sprint
flavour: No hurry. Only speed.
note: Accuracy, armour, life, chaos resistance and attack leech.

name: Pale Harp
flavour: One string, two arrows.
note: An additional arrow, crit multiplier and attack speed on a bow.

name: Pale Dirge
flavour: Three notes at once.
note: Two additional arrows, added physical, crit multiplier and attack speed on a bow.

name: Faithkeeper Visor
flavour: Faith, riveted on.
note: Attack speed, armour and evasion, chaos resistance and movement speed at less physical damage.

name: Starlit Skean
flavour: A blade only the dark can see.
note: Spell damage, spell crit, life and mana on kill and spell crit multiplier when nothing has died recently.

name: Venomtongue Gloves
flavour: They whisper only the cruel parts.
note: Spell damage and added chaos to spells with energy shield, at a cast speed and mana cost price.

name: Corsair's Tricorne
flavour: Wears the sea and none of the gold.
note: Added cold to attacks, evasion, mana, lightning resistance and immune to shock.

name: Vixen Hide
flavour: Hard to see, easy to follow.
note: Added physical, dexterity, evasion and a flat evasion rating on full life.

name: Penny Cap
flavour: A little luck, a little polish.
note: Evasion, item rarity, all resistances and reflected physical damage.

name: Mindful Claw
flavour: It thinks before it moves, and moves anyway.
note: Life on hit, elemental damage with attacks, added lightning and attack speed.

name: Wise Claw
flavour: The older twin of the Mindful Claw.
note: Life on hit, elemental attack damage, dexterity and intelligence and added lightning.

name: Seer's Charm
flavour: It sees the blow before the blow is thrown.
note: Accuracy and dodging attacks and spells.

name: Gaoler's Claw
flavour: Two doors, one key.
note: Life on hit, physical damage, added physical, attack speed and accuracy.

name: Rimeguard Buckler
flavour: Frost on the face, fire in the hand.
note: Movement speed, evasion, cold resistance and maximum, physical gained as cold.

name: Penitent's Circlet
flavour: Pain becomes a kind of armour.
note: A big energy shield, reflect, extra physical taken from attacks and Pain Conduit.

name: Brawn Girdle
flavour: Hold your breath and your belly.
note: Added physical, strength, life, cold resistance and flask life recovery rate.

name: Hush-walk Boots
flavour: Even the snow forgets the footprint.
note: Added cold to spells, spell crit, evasion, cold resistance and movement speed.

name: Cinder Totem
flavour: The fire is the watchman.
note: Fire damage, life, regeneration and evasion on low life.

name: Hail Bow
flavour: It hits like a downpour, thin and everywhere.
note: A short bow with double attack speed and damage for 30% less damage, and fast projectiles.

name: Harvester's Chase
flavour: The crop runs, and does not get far.
note: Physical damage, life on kill, item rarity, culling strike and movement speed on full life.

name: Crimson Greaves
flavour: Walk through it, not around it.
note: Life, added physical, armour, fire resistance and a lower enemy stun threshold.

name: Spark Quiver
flavour: A little electric whenever it is opened.
note: Dexterity, cast speed, life, lightning resistance, avoid stun and lightning damage.

name: Sapling Kite
flavour: Green and unbothered.
note: Elemental resistance, armour and energy shield, regeneration and freeze duration reduction.

name: Thunderstride Greaves
flavour: Every step leaves a charge.
note: Lightning resistance, movement speed, long shocks and physical converted to lightning.

name: Tidemark Ring
flavour: The line where the sea gave up.
note: Added cold against chilled enemies, added cold to attacks and spells, evasion and chill avoidance.

name: Heartwood Kite
flavour: A tree that learned to hold a shield.
note: Armour and energy shield, big life, regeneration and freeze duration reduction.

name: Ruinwake Boots
flavour: Look back only to check it was worth it.
note: Movement speed, added lightning to attacks, life on kill and armour and energy shield.

name: Thornwall
flavour: The thicker sibling of the Thornjerkin.
note: A big flat armour with reflect, added physical and less physical taken from attacks.

name: Windhide Wrap
flavour: Fast, light and breathable, for the tired.
note: A higher-level Quickhide Wrap: attack speed, evasion, cold resistance, movement speed and flask mana recovery.

name: Rimeheart
flavour: It keeps beating, slowly.
note: Dexterity, life, cold resistance, immune to chill and regeneration while frozen.

name: Cinder Heart
flavour: It warms the chest and nobody else.
note: Strength, fire damage, life and fire resistance.
